inclusions.text: Pick-up from your hotel and transfer to the departure point
inclusions.source: The day begins with a pick-up from your hotel and a transfer to the departure point, where guides deliver a safety briefing before anyone mounts a bike.
Departure and Safety Briefing: Begin your adventure with a comprehensive safety briefing from our experienced tour guides.

inclusions.text: Transfers return riders to their hotels
inclusions.source: Guides navigate back to the departure point, and transfers return riders to their hotels.
